changelog:
Initial release of performance-regression-triage skill.

- Triages performance regressions using concrete evidence (latency percentiles, error rates, resource/DB metrics, deploys).
- Separates symptoms from hypotheses and recommends one targeted measurement before any fix.
- Outlines common regression causes and a stepwise triage process.
- Emphasizes smallest-change-first, behavior preservation, and explicit verification criteria.
- Includes optional knowledge capture in portable OKF format, with user approval.
- Works fully standalone; optional Ritual Cloud upgrade for advanced context and team workflows.
